### Dying Well
Author: Derek Thomas
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/dying-well
Passage: Genesis 23:1-2
Points:
- Grieving and weeping over the loss of a spouse is natural and fully appropriate for God's people.
- Abraham and Sarah navigated severe marital strain and long waiting, yet genuine covenant love prevailed.
- Sarah's death reminded Abraham that he remained a pilgrim and foreigner waiting for a better heavenly country.
- Buying the cave of Machpelah was an act of faith asserting that God would eventually give them the land.
- Sarah's burial served as a down payment proving that physical death cannot overturn the Lord's promises.

### The Field of Ephron
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/field-ephron
Passage: Genesis 23:16
Points:
- Abraham chose to bury Sarah in Canaan rather than returning to his ancestral homeland, acting by faith.
- He rejected informal offers from the Hittites and insisted on purchasing the land outright at full price.
- Paying the steep cost prevented Abraham and his descendants from being indebted to the local inhabitants.
- Acquiring this small burial site established his first legal ownership in Canaan as a pledge of God's covenant promise.
- Christians are encouraged to invest resources faithfully to advance God's kingdom and leave a spiritual inheritance.
